## Owner

---


[__Bi-entity Condition Type__](https://eggolib.github.io/latest/types/bientity_condition_types/owner)

Checks if the actor entity is the owner of the tamable or ownable target entity.

Type ID: `eggolib:owner`

---

### Examples

=== "Example #1"

    ```json
    "bientity_condition": {
        "type": "eggolib:owner"
    }
    ```



[1]: ../bientity_condition_types.md
